paper.title: Molecular signatures of antibody responses derived from a systems biology study of five human vaccines

how_this_was_built: Enumerated by hand from the Results prose of data/claims/SDY1260_24336226_jats_figures/jats_text.txt and the figure/table legends in raw.xml.

Granularity follows the project's own split/merge rules (apps/api/app/prompts/extract_claims_pdf.txt): one claim per subject group; one claim per assertion (split when comparison structure, metric, timepoint, assay or statistical relationship differs); merge multiple targets sharing one assertion.
The Figure 1d SBA sentence is the worked example the project prompt itself scores as 4 assertions x 2 groups = 8 claims; Tier 1 reproduces that reading.

scoring.tier_1: Results section 1 (Figure 1 + Table 1). Assertions are crisp and enumerable; scored strictly. G01-G36.
scoring.tier_2: Results sections 2-6 (Figures 2-6 + supplementary). Module/enrichment statements have genuinely ambiguous granularity; scored loosely and reported separately. G37-G87.
scoring.merge_ok: Marked assertions may legitimately be merged with the assertion named in merge_with. Counting them merged is not an error; missing both is.
scoring.optional: Marked assertions rest on 'data not shown' or are borderline under the grounding gate. Neither extracting nor omitting them is penalised.
scoring.table_1_trap: Table 1 is a study-design table stating no findings. Claims sourced to Table 1 that merely restate a Figure 1 assertion are DUPLICATES, not new claims. A correct extractor emits ~0 finding-claims for Table 1.
